h1: Velo and backend code for Wix apps
overview: Behind every smooth Wix app is backend code that stores data and talks to other services. We write it in Velo or in your app's server code: data collections with the right permissions, web methods and HTTP functions, scheduled jobs and calls to outside APIs. Secrets stay in the Wix Secrets Manager, errors are logged, and each endpoint is tested and documented.

faq: Is Velo the same as the Wix CLI?
No. Velo is Wix's built-in development platform for sites, with backend files and collections. The CLI is for building apps. We work with both and tell you which fits your project.
Can you add backend code to my existing site?
Yes. We enable Velo on your site, or on a copy first if you prefer, and add the code there. Your pages and content stay as they are.
How do you keep API keys safe?
We store them in the Wix Secrets Manager and read them only in backend code, never in the browser. We never ask for passwords. Add us as a collaborator or send keys through a secure channel.
Will it handle lots of data?
We design for it. Wix collections have limits on size and request rates, so we use paging, indexes and background jobs. We tell you in the notes where the limits are.
